test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

Ankur answered all the questions correctly in the interview.

options.text: All the questions were answered correctly by Ankur in the interview.
All the questions have been answered correctly by Ankur in the interview.
All the questions had been answered correctly by Ankur in the interview.
In the interview all the questions are answered correctly by Ankur

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1** i.e. *"All the questions were answered correctly by Ankur in the interview."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In passive voice,** the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The **original sentence **is in the simple past tense **("answered")**, so the passive voice should also be in the simple past tense **("were answered").**
 
• The original subject **("Ankur")** is placed after the verb in the passive sentence, prefixed by **"by".**
 
• The sentence ensures that all elements of the original meaning are retained without altering the context.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *"All the questions were answered correctly by Ankur in the interview."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **Uses the present perfect tense ("have been answered") instead of simple past tense.
 
• **Option 3:** Uses the past perfect tense ("had been answered"), which is unnecessary in this context.
 
• **Option 4: **Uses the present tense ("are answered") instead of simple past tense.
